hooks.command: jq -r ".prompt // empty" | grep -qiE "\"write[^\"]{0,20}read[^\"]{0,10}\"" && echo "Alan sent the write-back shorthand. Run the FULL write-back now: 1-3 episodes covering the day so far, any candidate lessons (pending, never self-confirmed), then embed-backfill, then PROVE the read-back by recalling today through the scoped wrapper. Report the proof to Alan via the reply tool." || true
